evals.prompt: Review the diff in fixtures/security-route/diff.patch (a new GET /pulls/:id/files/search route added to server/src/modules/pulls/routes.ts) as you would review a teammate's pull request before it merges.
evals.expected_output: Flags SQL injection via sql.raw(), the missing workspace/tenant scoping (IDOR), and the GitHub token written to the log on failure.
expectations: The review flags SQL injection risk in the new route's query, specifically the use of sql.raw() with unsanitized user input, at or above high/critical severity.
The review flags the missing workspace/tenant scoping on the PR lookup (broken access control / IDOR) at or above high/critical severity.
The review flags that the GitHub token is being written to the application log in the error handler.

evals.prompt: Review the diff in fixtures/onion-notify-service/diff.patch (a new server/src/modules/pulls/notify.ts, PrNotifyService) as you would review a teammate's pull request before it merges.
evals.expected_output: Flags the repository built inside the constructor instead of taken as a parameter, the raw external fetch with no port/adapter, and the secret read from process.env instead of SecretsProvider.
expectations: The review flags that PrNotifyService constructs its own repository inside the constructor instead of receiving it as a parameter.
The review flags that the external Slack webhook call is a raw fetch with no port/adapter abstraction.
The review flags that the webhook URL is read from process.env instead of the repo's SecretsProvider.

evals.prompt: Review the diff in fixtures/frontend-label-filter/diff.patch (a new LabelQuickFilter component under client/src/app/repos/[repoId]/pulls/_components/) as you would review a teammate's pull request before it merges.
evals.expected_output: Flags fetch called directly in the component instead of via a hook, query data copied into useState instead of derived, and a shareable filter kept in local state instead of the URL.
expectations: The review flags that fetch is called directly inside the component instead of through a lib/hooks/ hook.
The review flags that query data (pulls) is copied into local useState instead of being derived from the query result during render.
The review flags that the shareable selectedLabel filter is kept in local component state instead of the URL.
